data.body: **P2:** On the ADOT dual-class-loader path, the agent-side `KEY` cannot retrieve the `AtomicReference` stored by the application-side copy, so only the system property is consumed here. `SpanProcessor.onStart` still receives a parent containing the populated application-side holder; forwarding it to an application-owned provider incorrectly applies the durable sampling decision to an unrelated span. Avoid adding the context-key carrier on the cross-loader/global-provider path, or use a carrier genuinely shared between loaders, and add a two-loader regression that forwards the original parent after agent-side consumption.
